reader_summary.overview: Classics are my favorite episodes from the past 10 years published once a month. These are N of one conversations with N of one people. There's nobody I've met quite like Doug Leone. Doug led one of the world’s most successful venture firms, Sequoia, for over 25 years after he was given responsibility for the firm by its founder.

key_points.text: Doug led one of the world’s most successful venture firms, Sequoia.
Alongside Mike Moritz, the pair managed its expansion from a single $150m early-stage fund into an $85 billion global powerhouse.
It was a privilege to sit down with Doug and learn from him.
